body.title: Register pass-through codecs for the five missing kinds
body.summary: Register pass-through codecs for EPIC, STORY, TASKS, TASK and DIAG in src/workflow/artifact-core/codecs.ts (body and citations opaque, identity meta from the creation context) and update the s2 assertions that pinned the old registry: the registeredKinds list in codec-create.test.ts and the unknown-kind checks for TASK and STORY in store-write.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: registeredKinds lists all sixteen kinds and codecFor no longer throws for any id kind
a TASK, STORY, EPIC, TASKS and DIAG head can be encoded, decoded and written through the store, and a TASK write with a wrong parent still fails on its parent first
the other s2 tests pass unchanged

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/pass-through-codecs.test.ts: a TASK, STORY, EPIC, TASKS and DIAG head is written, read, listed and given a status through the store, and registeredKinds lists sixteen kinds
